gemini-2.5-flash.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 7 states 'Prior period reserve deterioration was GBP 5.2 million', while Note 5 states 'The prior year's net provision for claims outstanding generated a deficit for 2018 ... (5,177)'. Both indicate a strengthening, and the amounts are very close. The figure from Note 5 (GBP 5.177m) was used for prior_year_development_gbp_m. The individual LOB movements in Note 5 sum to -GBP 5.177m (a net release), which contradicts the overall strengthening. The LOB movements were interpreted as impact on profit (positive = favourable, negative = adverse) and then signs reversed to represent movement in provision (positive = strengthening, negative = release) to align with the overall net strengthening of GBP 5.177m. Gross premiums written are negative due to adjustments made in the year to premiums for contracts entered into prior to 2017, as the syndicate was in run-off.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (2017 closing = opening 2018). Prior year development taken from narrative note and Movement in Prior Year's Provision table which explicitly quantifies a GBP 5.177k deterioration.
